description.value: PriceSmart Foods is a British Columbia supermarket chain known for competitive pricing and a wide selection of fresh produce, deli items, bakery goods, and prepared meals. The Austin Road location serves the Coquitlam area and stocks a broad range of everyday grocery staples that touring cyclists can use to restock. The chain also offers ready-made deli meals, which can be convenient for cyclists looking for a quick, substantial meal.
